thread:
sally-sales: OmniBank POC failing when streaming long outputs via our TS SDK behind their corporate Bluecoat proxy. They get 'socket hang up' / ECONNRESET around 30s, can we swarm?
mike-eng: How are they calling stream? Any snippet? streaming vs polling matters.
sally-sales: Streaming. They pasted this:
> const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.R_API });
> const r = await client.chat.stream({ model: 'rwd-3-small', messages });
> // hangs ~30s then error: 'socket hang up'
kevin-support: Most likely proxy idle timeout or proxy rewriting Connection headers. Also Node fetch might not be using keep-alive.
anna-devex: For TS SDK the usual guidance is using an http(s).Agent with keepAlive:true. Example quick patch for customers who can add deps:
```
import fetch from 'node-fetch';
import { Agent } from 'http';
const agent = new Agent({ keepAlive: true });
await client.chat.stream({...}, { fetch: (url, opts) => fetch(url, { ...opts, agent }) });
```
mike-eng: We can also add client-side reconnect/resume in the runtime so a dropped stream resumes from last cursor. That needs an experimental change but doable.
sally-sales: OmniBank cannot install extra packages or custom agents in their locked image. They only have stock Node 18 and corporate constraints. Any hosted-side workaround?
kevin-support: Short-term: recommend switching to polling/chunked mode — works over most proxies. Long-term: provide a dedicated connector in their VPC or add a proxy-compatibility header from our side.
mike-eng: We'll spin a canary for a transparent stream-resume (reconnect + resume token). deploy-bot: canary deploying stream-resume-experimental -> infra-canary-5.
jess-security: If we suggest dedicated connector, OmniBank will need a 1-pager: KMS integration, audit logs, egress IPs, auth model. I'll draft it.
sally-sales: They also asked rough POC pricing for a week of a small dedicated connector handling sustained streams. Can we give a ballpark to move procurement?
anna-devex: Ballpark: small ephemeral Dedicated pool (2x A10G equiv) + egress bandwidth. I'll ping billing for a formal line item but tell OmniBank: expect a short fixed connector fee + usage.
kevin-support: For triage ask them to capture a pcap of the stream for the first 60s and copy HTTP headers around the FIN. If Bluecoat sends Connection: close at 30s that's the smoking gun.
omni-bank-ic: Uploading pcap and header dump now. Thanks, team.
kevin-support: Received pcap. Proxy sends FIN at ~29.9s, no RST from server; looks like idle-timeout tear-down. I'll sanitize and share trace.
mike-eng: If proxy strips keep-alive our only immediate fix is fallback polling or temporary tunnel via our outbound proxy (requires their firewall to allow one IP).
sally-sales: They don't want infra changes. Asked whether SDK can auto-fallback to polling on disconnect.
anna-devex: We can add STREAM_AUTO_FALLBACK flag to the SDK to automatically retry as polling after a streaming failure. Quick minor release should cover their case.
mike-eng: I'll open the RFC and gate it behind an experimental flag so we can enable per-customer. If urgent, we can flip it for OmniBank's API key.
kevin-support: Meanwhile, ask them to try env vars: NODE_OPTIONS='--max-http-header-size=32768' and ensure they aren't using a corporate HTTP agent that forces Connection: close. Not foolproof.
sally-sales: Next steps I told OmniBank: 1) send pcap & headers (done), 2) try polling fallback snippet (TS + Python), 3) we will provide POC pricing for a dedicated connector, 4) engineering will canary stream-resume and consider enabling fallback flag for them — target 24-48h.
omni-bank-ic: Thanks for the rapid help, uploading pcap now :pray:
deploy-bot: canary health check started for stream-resume-experimental (build 2025.05.02-rc)
kevin-support: Sending sanitized pcap + header dump to sally-sales via DM.
jess-security: Drafted connector security checklist (KMS, audit retention, egress, cert rotation). Sharing by EOD for procurement.
anna-devex: I'll prepare TS & Python polling fallback snippets and a short support doc to link in the POC notes.
sally-sales: I'll chase billing and legal once I have the quote. Thanks team :thumbsup:
